# The Scotsman

> > Scotland's national newspaper covering news, food & drink, and community celebrations through NationalWorld Celebrations.

The Scotsman is a historic Scottish publication providing journalism, lifestyle content, and community services. The site includes specialized sections for food and drink coverage featuring Scottish cuisine, whisky, and culinary guides, as well as celebration announcements and community notices through the NationalWorld Celebrations platform.

## Key Topics

- NationalWorld Celebrations
- Scotsman
- Scottish food and drink
- Whisky pronunciation
- Community announcements
- Edinburgh News
- Sean Murphy
- Scottish cuisine
- Celebrations and notices
- Culinary guides
- Scottish distilleries
- Local journalism

## Community Celebrations & Announcements

- [Home | NationalWorld Celebrations](https://celebrations.scotsman.com): NationalWorld Celebrations homepage for Scotsman announcements
- [Home | NationalWorld Celebrations](https://celebrations.edinburghnews.scotsman.com): Edinburgh News celebrations & community notices homepage
- [Help | NationalWorld Celebrations](https://celebrations.scotsman.com/help): Contact form & help for NationalWorld Celebrations registration

## Food & Drink Guides

- [How to eat lobster, a guide to ordering in a restaurant | Scotsman Food and Drink](https://foodanddrink.scotsman.com/food/how-to-eat-lobster-a-guide-to-ordering-in-a-restaurant): Guide to eating lobster featuring Scotland's top chefs by Sean Murphy
- [The Scotsman's guide to Scotch whisky pronunciation | Scotsman Food and Drink](https://foodanddrink.scotsman.com/drink/scotsmans-guide-scotch-whisky-pronunciation): Video guide: How to pronounce Scottish distillery names correctly
- [A beginner's guide to making your own gin at home | Scotsman Food and Drink](https://foodanddrink.scotsman.com/drink/beginners-guide-making-gin-home): Craft Gin Club's guide to homemade bathtub gin & botanicals
